{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured blazer with trousers, sharp lapel cut, full length reaching mid-thigh, charcoal gray #3a3f45, fine wool blend with a subtle herringbone weave.
Silk blouse, tailored collar, standard fit extending to the hips, ivory white #f8f6f2, crisp 100% silk with a slight sheen.
Pumps, pointed toe, classic stiletto heel height of 7 cm, deep navy blue #1b2a41, smooth polished leather with a rounded square silhouette.
This outfit works because the structured charcoal blazer and matching trousers immediately project the professional authority required for an analyst role at a bank. The ivory silk blouse provides a necessary visual break against the dark outer layer while maintaining a crisp, clean neckline appropriate for a morning interview at ten o'clock. The pointed-toe navy pumps elevate the ensemble from casual business wear to formal attire without appearing overly severe or distracting from your qualifications."}
